questions.question: The word ‘Veda’ refers to which of the following?
In India, the term ‘Judicial Activism' is related to which of the following issues?
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'A' (Public Interest Petition) है।

questions.question: Which of the following was a special post created by Alauddin Khilji for the purpose of collecting revenue?
Select the correct formula of personal income.
options: NI − Distributed profits − Net interest payments made by households − Corporate tax + Transfer payments to the households from the government
NI − Undistributed profits − Net interest payments made by households − Corporate tax − Transfer payments to the households from the government
NI − Undistributed profits − Net interest payments made by households − Corporate tax + Transfer payments to the households from the government
NI − Undistributed profits − Corporate tax + Transfer payments to the households from the government
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'C' (NI − Undistributed profits − Net interest payments made by households − Corporate tax + Transfer payments to the households from the government) है।

questions.question: In the domain of infrastructure, BOT is used widely. What does 'O' stand for in BOT?
The Citizenship Act 1955 was amended for the first time in which of the following years?
The characteristic smell of egg yolk is because of _______.
In which of the following years and cities did the British East India Company establish its first factory in India?
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'A' (1613 at Surat) है।

questions.question: Which of the following schemes is NOT run by the Ministry of Rural Development?
options: Pt. Deen Dayal Upadhyaya Grameen Kaushalya Yojana
Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee Scheme
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'A' (Atmanirbhar Bharat Rojgar Yojana) है।

questions.question: CAC is an international organisation that has contributed to the improvement of food safety, quality and security, promoting research and facilitating trade. The full form of CAC is _______.
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'C' (Codex Alimentarius Commission) है।

questions.question: Registration of Births and Deaths in India became legally mandatory with the enactment of which legislation?
options: Population Data Collection and Certification Act, 1968
Vital Statistics (National Compilation and Maintenance) Act, 1970
Registration of Births and Deaths (RBD) Act, 1969
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'D' (Registration of Births and Deaths (RBD) Act, 1969) है।

questions.question: In 1956, as per the Reorganisation Commission, how many States and UTs were created?
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'D' (14 States and 6 UTs) है।

questions.question: At what age did D Gukesh win the World Chess Championship in 2024?
In August 2025, a population survey by the State Forest Department reported an increase in the estimated population of which reptile in the Sundarban Biosphere Reserve?
When was the Treaty of Purandar signed between the Mughal commander Raja Jai Singh and Chhatrapati Shivaji?
What is the name of the heaviest rocket developed by ISRO that will be used to launch Mangalyaan-2 mission?
Among the languages written in the Constitution, which language is the least spoken?
Which Union Territory lies close to the Malabar Coast of Kerala?
The term ‘Acheulian’ is used to describe which kind of tools, as used by early humans?
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'C' (Symmetrical hand-axes and cleavers) है।

questions.question: Which of the following schemes launched on 10 July 2024 seeks solutions to the problems related to the shipyards?
options: Garden Reach Shipbuilders & Engineers Limited Accelerated Innovation Nurturing Scheme (GAINS 2024)
Reliance Naval and Engineering Limited Accelerated Innovation Nurturing Scheme (RAINS 2024)
Cochin Shipyard Accelerated Innovation Nurturing Scheme (CAINS 2024)
Hindustan Shipyard Accelerated Innovation Nurturing Scheme (HAINS 2024)
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'A' (Garden Reach Shipbuilders & Engineers Limited Accelerated Innovation Nurturing Scheme (GAINS 2024)) है।
